heading: INT. POLAR STATION HALLEY-9, MEDICAL BAY - NIGHT

units.text: INT. POLAR STATION HALLEY-9, MEDICAL BAY - NIGHT
A cramped clinic: one exam bed, one monitor, one satellite screen glowing blue on the wall.
Wind howls at the walls.
DR. SUNNIVA ERIKSEN, 40s, the station physician, stands at the screen with her arms crossed.
IBRAHIM TARAWNEH, 30s, a mechanic, sits on the bed with a bandaged hand and a gray face.
Dr. Lakshmi, can you hear me?
units.name: SUNNIVA

units.text: I can. Go ahead, Sunniva. Describe the wound.
units.name: LAKSHMI

units.text: Laceration across the palm, six centimeters. Clean edges. He's been bleeding for an hour.
units.name: SUNNIVA

units.text: It's fine.
units.name: IBRAHIM

units.text: Mr. Tarawneh, I need you to keep your hand elevated.
units.name: LAKSHMI

units.text: It's elevated.
units.name: IBRAHIM

units.text: It's on your knee.
units.name: SUNNIVA

units.text: I'm resting it on my knee.
units.name: IBRAHIM

units.text: Sunniva, what's his heart rate?
units.name: LAKSHMI

units.text: One-ten. Pressure ninety over sixty.
units.name: SUNNIVA

units.text: That's low for a hand wound.
units.name: LAKSHMI

units.text: I'm cold.
units.name: IBRAHIM

units.text: You're not cold, you're pale.
units.name: SUNNIVA

units.text: Mr. Tarawneh, how did you cut it?
units.name: LAKSHMI

units.text: Generator. A panel slipped.
units.name: IBRAHIM

units.text: That's not what you told me.
units.name: SUNNIVA

units.text: It's what happened.
units.name: IBRAHIM

units.text: Ibrahim, I'm going to ask you directly. Did you take anything for the pain?
units.name: LAKSHMI

units.text: No.
units.name: IBRAHIM

units.text: Ibrahim.
units.name: SUNNIVA

units.text: A few of the white ones. Maybe six.
units.name: IBRAHIM

units.text: Six what?
units.name: LAKSHMI

units.text: Oxycodone. The stock bottle. It's empty.
units.name: SUNNIVA

units.text: The stock bottle held sixty tablets.
units.name: LAKSHMI

units.text: I had a long winter.
units.name: IBRAHIM

units.text: Ibrahim, how many?
units.name: SUNNIVA

units.text: All of them. Since October.
units.name: IBRAHIM

units.text: Sunniva, this is no longer a hand injury.
units.name: LAKSHMI

units.text: I know.
units.name: SUNNIVA

units.text: Please don't tell the crew.
units.name: IBRAHIM

units.text: We will talk about that after we keep you alive.
units.name: LAKSHMI
